summary: The proposed [5,7] correction is independently justified by the literal script and CR103/305/601. Both players keep seven cards. P0 reaches its third turn, skips its first draw, draws twice, plays Forests at records 4 and 38, and casts Bear Cub at 39 and Giant Growth at 81: 7+2−2−2=5. P1 draws on both turns and plays Forests at 21 and 64: 7+2−2=7. Each 40-card library therefore contains 40−7−2=31 cards. Records 0–100 comprise 101 decisions; record 101 is an out-of-band concession, giving 102 consumed records and zero remaining. Four Forests plus Cub give five battlefield cards; Growth gives one graveyard card. The unblocked 5/5 Cub leaves life [20,15]. Changing only the hand expectation retains equivalent coverage, including every script record and all life, zone, count, completion and determinism assertions. No README change is needed for this expectation-only correction. No files were edited, tests executed, network accessed or other reviewer invoked.
